name: fresh-subscribe-replays-reserved-preview
description: A SHOULD (SPEC §12.2.1, the ggui#1521 erratum): a fresh subscribe (no `fromSeq`) replays a known-reserved channel's retained envelopes after the ack, at `seq ≤ streamSeq`, so a view that attaches after a lifecycle envelope was sent still sees it. The server emits an A2UI `createSurface` on `_ggui:preview` (a known-reserved channel) BEFORE the runner opens the socket and subscribes; the runner-owned fresh subscribe IS the probe (the inputEnvelope is descriptive, not dispatched), and nothing is emitted after it, so a matching `data` frame can only be the replay. Expected: a `data` frame on `_ggui:preview` carrying the emitted body, after the subscribe's `ack` and at a `seq` at or below its `streamSeq` (`replayAfterAck`); a frame above `streamSeq` would be a live emission, not the replay. One emission is graded, so the case does not tell a full replay of every retained envelope from a latest-only one. A server that does not replay is graded a WARNING, never a failure: agent-declared channels replay nothing on a fresh subscribe (invariant 1), and a server may decline the SHOULD.
